openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found. Every lead places the institution in Kharkiv: the Ministry of Education licence register for Kharkiv oblast (data stated as current at 05.05.2026) lists ПЗВО "Університет медицини та соціальних наук", and the education.ua profile (undated) shows a Kharkiv institution with a faculty of medicine, dormitory, preparatory department and military department (~238 students, 69 teachers; third-party figures, unverified). The osvita.ua rename report quotes president Anton Smirnov: "зміна назви не вплине на навчальний процес. Усі освітні програми, документи та права студентів залишаються без змін". Kharkiv is a frontline city; the teaching format (in-person/online) during hostilities is unverified. Rename date not shown in the search results.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Identity split across sources: the MON register and osvita.ua carry the new name 'Університет медицини та соціальних наук', while NAQA (English), EQAR, Lecturio and directories still use 'Kharkiv Institute of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences'; the domain lead khim.edu.ua comes from a third-party directory and may be stale after the rename (no new domain found).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Relationship to PHEE 'Kyiv Medical University' (inventory slug kyiv-medical-university) is unexplained: a directory names it 'Kharkiv Institute of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences of PHEE Kyiv Medical University' and a KMU document surfaced in the rename search, yet the MON register lists it as a separate private HEI under the new name. Whether it was a KMU branch that became a separate legal entity, and when, is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Accreditation of the only medical degree programme (Medicine 222, Master's) was granted by AHPGS for one year only, until 21 October 2026 (NAQA, decision 14 Oct 2025) — that date has passed as of 2026-10-24 and no renewal lead was found; the 2021 NAQA record shows a conditional term pending an on-site visit.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion risk with two other Kharkiv institutions: Kharkiv International Medical University (KhIMU, khimu.edu.ua, private; inventory slug kharkiv-international-medical-university) and the state Kharkiv National Medical University (KNMU). Agent sites returned for this institution's name actually describe KhIMU/KNMU fees and MBBS intakes — none of those figures apply here.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No international-applicants page, English-medium programme page, tuition or admissions information for foreigners was found; the only English-medium lead is a third-party atlas entry (Lecturio) with most fields marked 'TBA'.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Young and small institution per third-party leads: founded 2017 (village.ai) or 2018 (Lecturio); ~238 students and 69 teachers (education.ua) — figures unverified.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Kharkiv is a frontline city; teaching format and campus access during hostilities unverified (no relocation report found either way).
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Dentistry and pharmacy: no programme leads found; the directory must not imply them.

Skeptic's note: Identity split: the MON higher-education licence register (Kharkiv oblast, stated current at 05.05.2026) and an osvita.ua news item carry a new name, ПЗВО «Університет медицини та соціальних наук», while NAQA (English), EQAR, Lecturio and directories still use 'Kharkiv Institute of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences'. The rename date, legal basis and official English form are unconfirmed; no English source uses the new name.

Skeptic's note: Relationship to the candidate kyiv-medical-university is unexplained: one directory (village.ai) calls it 'Kharkiv Institute of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences of PHEE Kyiv Medical University', yet the MON register lists it as a separate private HEI. Treated as a separate institution on the strength of the register lead; not confirmed.

Skeptic's note: Only medical degree lead (Medicine 222, Master's) was accredited by AHPGS for one year to 21 Oct 2026 per NAQA; that date has passed and no renewal lead exists. Open question, not a bar for a name-only listing.
